title: The Wallace problem in ZFC
abstract: Formalizes in ZFC a Hausdorff countably compact group topology without nontrivial convergent sequences on every torsion-free Abelian group of cardinality continuum. It specializes the construction to the rational direct sum and the additive real group, and derives a commutative Tychonoff countably compact cancellative semigroup that is not a group.

informal.Wallace.torsionFreeAbelianGroup_mainTheo: Every torsion-free Abelian group of cardinality continuum admits a Hausdorff countably compact group topology with no nontrivial convergent sequences.
informal.Wallace.continuumRationalGroup_and_real_: Both the continuum-indexed rational direct sum and the additive group of real numbers admit such Hausdorff countably compact group topologies without nontrivial convergent sequences.
informal.Wallace.commutativeTychonoffWallaceCount: There exists a commutative Tychonoff countably compact topological semigroup with two-sided cancellation which is not a group.
